remarks: Located on a peaceful cul-de-sac yet just minutes from town, the train, and top-rated schools, this stunning home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience. Inside, you'll find high ceilings, beautiful moldings, custom built-ins, and an open floor plan designed for modern living. The large, renovated kitchen is a true centerpiece, featuring high-end finishes and generous space for cooking, dining, and gathering. The first floor also includes a beautifully updated living room, dining room, private office and a comfortable guest room, ideal for visitors or extended family.  Upstairs, you'll find four spacious bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite, plus a versatile great room perfect for a playroom, gym, or additional lounge space.   Set on a full acre of landscaped, fenced-in property, the outdoor area is ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. Enjoy the heated pool, unwind by the outdoor fireplace, or host memorable gatherings in your private backyard retreat. This home combines elegance, comfort, and an unbeatable location.
